# NEW 2026-11-22 v13.5 Worker 1: Master Artists, Works of Art, Epic Masterpieces & Zero-DLC World Heritage Linkage (oe_art_/oe_woa_/oe_mst_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v135_masters_wonders.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country-scope scripted effects for oe_mst_ (all modifiers use mode = replace; zero logging calls; O(1) yearly pulse guards).

oe_mst_catalogue_treasury_effect = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = oe_mst_catalogue_treasury_tt
		ordered_work_of_art_in_country = {
			limit = { art_quality < 98 }
			order_by = art_quality
			max = 2
			check_range_bounds = no
			change_art_quality = 4
		}
	}
	add_prestige = 8
}

# Called yearly per country by Stage Integrator's on_action/oe_v135_pulse.txt.
oe_mst_yearly_masterpiece_check = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_rebel_country = no }
		# Restitution pride / treasure loss vigilance notice (human-only, respects W2 oe_mst_restituted_pride_mod)
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = no
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_mst_restitution_alert_seen }
				OR = {
					has_country_modifier = oe_mst_restituted_pride_mod
					AND = {
						has_variable = oe_mst_custodian_flag
						NOT = {
							any_work_of_art_in_country = { art_quality >= 85 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_mst_restitution_alert_seen value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mst.14
		}
		# O(1) short-circuit guard: skip countries owning none of the 12 historical masterpiece anchors
		if = {
			limit = { oe_mst_owns_any_masterpiece_hub = yes }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_mst_art_1_done }
					current_year >= 1344
					current_year <= 1380
					oe_mst_eligible_for_art_1 = yes
				}
				set_global_variable = { name = oe_mst_art_1_done value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_mst_custodian_flag value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mst.1
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_mst_art_2_done }
					current_year >= 1365
					current_year <= 1415
					oe_mst_eligible_for_art_2 = yes
				}
				set_global_variable = { name = oe_mst_art_2_done value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_mst_custodian_flag value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mst.2
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_mst_art_3_done }
					current_year >= 1340
					current_year <= 1370
					oe_mst_eligible_for_art_3 = yes
				}
				set_global_variable = { name = oe_mst_art_3_done value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_mst_custodian_flag value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mst.3
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_mst_art_4_done }
					current_year >= 1475
					current_year <= 1535
					oe_mst_eligible_for_art_4 = yes
				}
				set_global_variable = { name = oe_mst_art_4_done value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_mst_custodian_flag value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mst.4
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_mst_art_5_done }
					current_year >= 1590
					current_year <= 1640
					oe_mst_eligible_for_art_5 = yes
				}
				set_global_variable = { name = oe_mst_art_5_done value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_mst_custodian_flag value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mst.5
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_mst_art_6_done }
					current_year >= 1680
					current_year <= 1756
					oe_mst_eligible_for_art_6 = yes
				}
				set_global_variable = { name = oe_mst_art_6_done value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_mst_custodian_flag value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mst.6
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_mst_art_7_done }
					current_year >= 1590
					current_year <= 1636
					oe_mst_eligible_for_art_7 = yes
				}
				set_global_variable = { name = oe_mst_art_7_done value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_mst_custodian_flag value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mst.7
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_mst_art_8_done }
					current_year >= 1560
					current_year <= 1630
					oe_mst_eligible_for_art_8 = yes
				}
				set_global_variable = { name = oe_mst_art_8_done value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_mst_custodian_flag value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mst.8
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_mst_art_9_done }
					current_year >= 1465
					current_year <= 1510
					oe_mst_eligible_for_art_9 = yes
				}
				set_global_variable = { name = oe_mst_art_9_done value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_mst_custodian_flag value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mst.9
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_mst_art_10_done }
					current_year >= 1568
					current_year <= 1595
					oe_mst_eligible_for_art_10 = yes
				}
				set_global_variable = { name = oe_mst_art_10_done value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_mst_custodian_flag value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mst.10
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_mst_art_11_done }
					current_year >= 1495
					current_year <= 1580
					oe_mst_eligible_for_art_11 = yes
				}
				set_global_variable = { name = oe_mst_art_11_done value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_mst_custodian_flag value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mst.11
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_mst_art_12_done }
					current_year >= 1540
					current_year <= 1665
					oe_mst_eligible_for_art_12 = yes
				}

# Called yearly per country by Stage Integrator's on_action/oe_v135_pulse.txt and by oe_mst_consecrate_world_heritage.
# Zero DLC dependency: pure location ownership soft linkage across all 16 D015/D017 world heritage sites.
oe_mst_yearly_heritage_check = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			at_war = no
			oe_mst_owns_any_world_heritage_site = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owns = location:giza
				location:giza = { NOT = { has_location_modifier = oe_mst_her_giza } }
			}
			location:giza = {
				add_location_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_mst_her_giza
					years = 25
					mode = replace
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owns = location:rome
				location:rome = { NOT = { has_location_modifier = oe_mst_her_colosseum } }
			}
			location:rome = {
				add_location_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_mst_her_colosseum
					years = 25
					mode = replace
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owns = location:athens
				location:athens = { NOT = { has_location_modifier = oe_mst_her_parthenon } }
			}
			location:athens = {
				add_location_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_mst_her_parthenon
					years = 25
					mode = replace
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owns = location:samarra

# Dev helper (Page 91 cmd 2501): recruit one sample of each of the 8 new artist types.
oe_mst_dev_recruit_all_8_masters = {
	create_character = {
		artist = oe_art_imperial_jurist
		artist_skill = 0.85
		estate = estate_type:burghers_estate
		min_age = 28
		max_age = 46
	}
	create_character = {
		artist = oe_art_persian_miniaturist
		artist_skill = 0.85
		estate = estate_type:burghers_estate
		min_age = 28
		max_age = 46
	}
	create_character = {
		artist = oe_art_imperial_kilnmaster
		artist_skill = 0.85

		max_age = 46

	create_character = {

		artist_skill = 0.85

		min_age = 28
		max_age = 46
	}
	create_character = {

		artist_skill = 0.85
		estate = estate_type:burghers_estate

		max_age = 46

	create_character = {

	}
}

# Dev helper (Page 91 cmd 2506): activate all owned D015/D017 heritage guardianships immediately.
oe_mst_dev_activate_owned_heritage = {
	oe_mst_yearly_heritage_check = yes
}

# Dev helper (Page 91 cmd 2507): simulate masterpiece restitution pride & alert event.
oe_mst_dev_simulate_restitution = {
	add_country_modifier = {
		modifier = oe_mst_restituted_pride_mod
		years = 10
		mode = replace
	}
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mst.14
}
